purpose: City-specific cadastral-source research; findings are limited to observed first-party evidence.
name: Arsi Negelle

queries.query: Arsi Negelle Ethiopia cadastral parcel map official GIS land registry
queries.result: Found official Ethiopian e-Land/Land Holding Registration and Information Agency infrastructure and the official e-Land map application. The public configuration and service are Addis-scoped; no Arsi Negelle-specific public parcel endpoint was found.

queries.query: Arsii Nageellee kaartaa lafa kadastrii mootummaa
queries.result: An official Oromo-language Oromia publication search result explicitly references Waajjira Lafa Magaalaa Nagellee Arsi and town land/map registry records. It evidences a local land-office custodian, but not an open parcel API or downloadable polygon service.

registryEvidence.basis: The official Oromia publication names Waajjira Lafa Magaalaa Nagellee Arsi (Arsi Negelle Town Land Office) in connection with town map/land registry records. This is local registry-office evidence, distinct from national agency prose.

officialSources.observation: Official e-Land viewer loaded anonymously; page identified the digital cadastral service.

Current production configuration exposed the public GeoServer WFS URL, Addis cityCode AA-ADS, workspace ncrprs_cadaster, parcel layer v_1_registered_parcel, and displayed source coordinates in EPSG:20137.
Official GeoServer WFS capabilities loaded. Registered parcel layer was listed with EPSG:20137 and Addis-area bounding coordinates, not Arsi Negelle coverage.
Parcel schema returned safe fields uniqueparcelid, documentedarea, measuredarea, parcel_type, geometry, and citycode.
Official Oromo-language publication named the Arsi Negelle town land office and referenced town land/map registry records.

requestsAndEndpointChecks.outcome: Current JavaScript configuration was inspected; it points to an Addis-only registered-parcel WFS and uses EPSG:20137.
Connection failed from the research host; no response was obtained. This is not evidence of service absence.
WFS capabilities returned; registered parcel layer extent is Addis-scoped.
Schema returned uniqueparcelid and geometry among safe fields.
Exact-point bounded response returned FeatureCollection with zero features. The point was not shifted; the Addis-scoped service miss is not treated as citywide absence.

sourceAssessment.operator: Arsi Negelle Town Land Office is evidenced locally in an official Oromia publication; e-Land/Land Holding Registration and Information Agency is national/additional infrastructure evidence.
sourceAssessment.verifiedOpenScope: No Arsi Negelle-specific anonymous parcel ID-plus-geometry response was verified.

coverageAssessment.claimedScope: Arsi Negelle local land-office existence is evidenced; e-Land public parcel service inspected is Addis-scoped.
coverageAssessment.verifiedOpenScope: No city-bounded or point-bounded Arsi Negelle anonymous cadastral parcel ID-plus-geometry response.
limits: The exact WUP point was preserved and not shifted.
The Addis WFS exact-point zero-feature response is a service extent miss, not evidence of citywide absence.
The local office publication is registry evidence but does not establish public machine-readable geometry.
The Ethio-NSDI connection failure and absent search result are not absence evidence.

remainingUncertainty: Arsi Negelle may have local or controlled cadastral map services not exposed anonymously. No login, credentials, CAPTCHA bypass, unsafe fields, or private data were used. This packet is complete as research evidence and is not source integration or runtime admission.
